intro: Make room for style and comfort with our Bliss bench. It adds flexible, cosy seating with a refined touch—perfect for family dinners or a stylish hallway statement.

features.title: Elegance in every detail
features.text: The walnut-toned Sheesham frame pairs effortlessly with light upholstery to give your space a warm, upscale look.

features.title: Rustic charm with natural wood grains
features.text: Every grain in the natural finish speaks of timeless craft—and a piece that grows with your life.

features.title: Durability you can trust
features.text: Crafted from seasoned, termite-resistant Sheesham wood, this bench is ready for years of reliable use.

features.title: Bold legs, balanced design
features.text: The criss-cross leg pattern adds visual interest while keeping your bench grounded, steady, and stylish.

features.title: Comfy to the core
features.text: With thick foam cushioning and tufted accents, your bench invites you to sit, stay, and savor the moment.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Bliss V2 Solid Wood Dining Bench
